facts.fact: The Ministry of Justice page states that the national civil identification and authentication system (SNIAC) was created by Lei n.º 43/VIII/2013 of 17 September 2013, an ordinary law, as the central system for identification, civil authentication and the citizen life cycle, run by the Direção-Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação (DGRNI); the page is undated and its published date (2020) is used only for currency.

systems.system: Sistema Nacional de Identificação e Autenticação Civil (SNIAC)
systems.owner: Direção-Geral dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação (Ministry of Justice)
systems.tiers: central government; data supplier to other public administration subsystems; supplies data for the CNI, electronic passport and residence title
citizens of Cabo Verdean nationality; valid 5 years

note: No cover fact: the page does not say the law provides for a biometric register, unique number or electronic check (electronic authentication is listed as a mission goal); Decreto-Lei n.º 30/2020 is cited only for a card fee.
